verses.sanskrit: येन तत्त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा क्षणाद्भस्मीकृतं पुरा । शरेणैकेन गोविन्द महादेवेन लीलया ॥२६२॥
verses.english: It was with that weapon that the great Mahadeva had, formerly burnt and consumed in a moment the triple city of the Asuras. With the greatest ease, O Govinda, Mahadeva, using that single arrow, performed that feat.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दहेत च यत्कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । महेश्वरभुजोत्सृष्टं निमेषार्धान्न संशयः ॥२६३॥
verses.english: That weapon, discharged by Mahadeva's arms, can, forsooth, consume in half the time taken up by a twinkling of the eye the entire universe with all its mobile and immobile creatures.

verses.sanskrit: नावध्यो यस्य लोकेस्मिन् ब्रह्मविष्णुसुरेष्वपि । तदहं दृष्टवांस्तत्र आश्चर्यमिद‌मुत्तमम् ॥२६४॥
verses.english: In the universe there is no one including, even Brahman and Vishnu and the celestials, who cannot be killed by that weapon. O sire, I saw that excellent, wonderful and peerless weapon in the hand of Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यमस्त्रवरं नान्यत्तत्तुल्यमधिकं हि वा । यत्तच्छूलमिति ख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु शूलिनः ॥२६५॥
verses.english: There is another mysterious and very strong weapon which is equal or, perhaps, superior to the Pashupata. I saw that also. It is known in all the worlds as the Shula of the Shula-armed Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: दारयेद्यां महीं कृत्स्नां शोषयेद्वा महोदधिम् । संहरेद्वा जगत्कृत्स्नं विसृष्टं शूलपाणिना ॥२६६॥
verses.english: Hurled by the illustrious god, that weapon can rive the entire Earth or dry up the waters of the occan or annihilate the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: यौवनाश्वो हतो येन मान्धाता सबलः पुरा । चक्रवर्ती महातेजास्त्रिलोकविजयी नृपः ॥२६७॥
verses.english: Formerly Yuvanashva's son, king Mandhatri, that conqueror of the three worlds, having imperial sway and gifted with profuse energy, was, with all his armies, killed by means of that weapon.

verses.sanskrit: महाबलो महावीर्यः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः । करस्थेनैव गोविन्द लवणस्येह रक्षसः ॥२६८॥
verses.english: Gifted with great might and great energy and resembling Shakra himself in prowess, that king, O Govinda, was killed by the Rakshasa Lavana with the help of this Shula which he had got from Shiva.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छूलमतितीक्ष्णाग्रं सुभीमं लोमहर्षणम् । त्रिशिखां भ्रुकुटिं कृत्वा तर्जमानमिव स्थितम् ॥२६९॥
verses.english: That Shula is keen-pointed. Highly terrible, it is capable of causing everybody's hair stand erect. 1 beheld it in the hand of Mahadeva, as if roaring with anger, having contracted its forehead into three wrinkles.

verses.sanskrit: विधूमं सार्चिषं कृष्णं कालसूर्यमिवोदितम् । सर्पहस्तमनिर्देश्यं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम् ॥२७०॥
verses.english: It resembled, O Krishna, a smokeless fire or the sun that rises at the end of the cycle. The handle of that Shula was made of a great snake. It is really indescribable. It looked like the universal Destroyer armed with his noose.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टवानस्मि गोविन्द तदस्त्रं रुद्रसन्निधौ । परशुस्तीक्ष्णधारश्च दत्तो रामस्य यः पुरा ॥२७१॥
verses.english: I saw this weapon, O Govinda, in the hand of Mahadeva. I saw also another weapon, viz., that shar-pedged battle-axe which, was given, formerly unto Rama by Mahadeva for enabling him to root out the Kshatriyas. It was with this weapon that Rama killed in dreadful battle the great Karttaviryya who was the king of the entire world.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवेन तुष्टेन क्षत्रियाणां क्षयंकरः । कार्तवीर्यो हतो येन चक्रवर्ती महामृधे ॥२७२॥
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी येन निःक्षत्रिया कृता । जामदग्न्येन गोविन्द रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥२७३॥
दीप्तधारः सुरौद्रास्यः सर्पकण्ठाग्रधिष्ठितः । अभवच्छूलिनोऽभ्याशे दीप्तवह्निशतोपमः ॥२७४॥
verses.english: Of blazing edge and highly terrible, that axe was hanging on the shoulder, adorned with a snake, of Mahadeva. Indeed, it appeared on Mahadeva's body like the flame of a burning fire.

verses.sanskrit: असंख्येयानि चास्त्राणि तस्य दिव्यानि धीमतः । प्राधान्यतो मयैतानि कीर्तितानि तवानघ ॥२७५॥
verses.english: I saw with the highly intelligent Mahadeva numberless other celestial weapons. I have, however, named only a few principal ones, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यदेशे तु देवस्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । दिव्यं विमानमास्थाय हंसयुक्तं मनोजवम् ॥२७६॥
verses.english: On the left side of the great god stood the Grandfather Brahman seated on an excellent car to which were yoked swans fleet-coursing like the mind.

verses.sanskrit: वामपार्श्वगतश्चापि तथा नारायणः स्थितः । वैनतेयं समारुह्य शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः ॥२७७॥
verses.english: On the same side was Narayana also, seated on Garuda and bearing the conch, the discus, and the mace.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दो मयूरमास्थाय स्थितो देव्याः समीपतः । शक्तिघण्टे समादाय द्वितीय इव पावकः ॥२७८॥
verses.english: Near the goddess Uma was Skanda seated on his peacock, bearing his dreadful arrow and bells, and loO king like another Fire-God.

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्ताच्चैव देवस्य नन्दिं पश्याम्यवस्थितम् । शूलं विष्टभ्य तिष्ठन्तं द्वितीयमिव शङ्करम् ॥२७९॥
verses.english: Before Mahadeva I saw Nandi standing armed with his Shula and loO king like a second Shankara.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवाद्या मनवो भृग्वाद्या ऋषयस्तथा । शक्राद्या देवताश्चैव सर्व एव समभ्ययुः ॥२८०॥
verses.english: The Munis headed by the Self create Manu, and the Rishis having Bhrigu for their first, and the gods with Shakra at their head, all came there.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतगणाश्चैव मातरो विविधाः स्थिताः । तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं परिवार्य समंततः ॥२८१॥
verses.english: All the clans of spirits and ghosts, and the celestial Mothers, stood surrounding Mahadeva and saluting him with respect.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तुवन्विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्महादेवं सुरास्तदा । ब्रह्मा भवं तदाऽस्तौषीद्रथन्तरमुदीरयन् ॥२८२॥
verses.english: The gods were engaged in singing the praises of Mahadeva in various hymns. The Grandfather Brahman, uttering a Rathantara, landed Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठसाम्ना च देवेशं जगौ नारायणस्तदा ॥२८३॥
verses.english: Ultering the Jyeshtha Saman Narayana also sang the praises of Bhava, Shakra also did the same with the help of those foremost of Vedic Mantras, viz., the Shata-Rudriyam.

verses.sanskrit: गृणन्ब्रह्म परं शक्रः शतरुद्रियमुत्तमम् । ब्रह्मा नारायणश्चैव देवराजश्च कौशिकः ॥२८४॥
अशोभन्त महात्मानस्त्रयस्त्रय इवाग्नयः । तेषां मध्यगतो देवो रराज भगवाञ्छिवः ॥२८५॥
verses.english: Verily, Brahman and Narayana and Shakra, those three great gods shone there like three sacrificial fires.

verses.sanskrit: शरदभ्रविनिर्मुक्तः परिधिस्थ इवांशुमान् । अयुतानि च चन्द्रार्कानपश्यं दिवि केशव ॥२८६॥
verses.english: In their midst was the illustrious god like the sun in the midst of his corona, come from autumnal clouds.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽहमस्तुवं देवं विश्वस्य जगतः पतिम् । उपमन्युरुवाच । नमो देवाधिदेवाय महादेवाय ते नमः ॥२८७॥
verses.english: I saw countless suns and moons also in the sky, O Keshava. I then lauded the illustrious Lord of everything, the Great Master of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: शक्ररूपाय शक्राय शक्रवेषधराय च । नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय पिङ्गलायारुणाय च ॥२८८॥
verses.english: Upamanyu said I said, Salutations to you, O illustrious one, O you who are the refuge of all things, O you who are called Mahadeva! Salutations to you who assume the form of Shakra, who are Shakra and who disguise yourself in the form of Shakra.

verses.sanskrit: पिनाकपाणय नित्यं शङ्खशूलधराय च । नमस्ते कृष्णवासाय कृष्णकुञ्चितमूर्धजे ॥२८९॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are armed with the thunder, to you who are tawny, and you who are red. Salutations to you who are always armed with the Pinaka, to you who always bear the conch and the Shula.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयाय कृष्णाष्टमिरताय च । शुक्लवर्णाय शुक्लाय शुक्लाम्बरधराय च ॥२९०॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are clad in black, to you who are of dark and curly hair, to you who have dark deerskin for your upper garment, to you who preside over the eighth lunation of the dark fortnight.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लभस्मावलिप्ताय शुक्लकर्मरताय च । नमोऽस्तु रक्तवर्णाय रक्ताम्बरधराय च ॥२९१॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are of white hue, to you who are called white, to you who are clad in white dress, to you who have limbs smeared with white ashes, to you who are ever engaged in white deeds.

verses.sanskrit: रक्तध्वजपताकाय रक्तस्रगनुलेपिने । नमोऽस्तु पीतवर्णाय पीताम्बरधराय च ॥२९२॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are red in colour, to you who are clad in red dress, to you who have a red banner with red flags, to you who wear red garlands and use red unguents.

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तूच्छ्रितच्छत्राय किरीटवरधारिणे । अर्धहारार्धकेयूर अर्धकुण्डलकर्णिने ॥२९३॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are brown coloured, to you who are clad in brown dress, to you who have a brown banner with brown flags, to you who wear brown garlands and use brown unguents. Salutations to you who have the umbrella of royalty held over your head, to you who wear the foremost of crowns.

verses.sanskrit: नमः पवनवेगाय नमो देवाय वै नमः । सुरेन्द्राय मुनीन्द्राय महेन्द्राय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥२९४॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are adorned with half a garland and half an armlet, to you who are decked with one ring for one ear, to you who are endued with the speed of the wind, to you who are highly effulgent.

verses.sanskrit: नमः पद्मार्थमालाय उत्पलैर्मिश्रिताय च । अर्धचन्दनलिप्ताय अर्धस्त्रगनुलेपिने ॥२९५॥
verses.english: Salutations to you who are the foremost of gods, to you who are the foremost of Munis, to you who are the foremost of celestials! Salutations to you who wear half a wreath of lotuses, to you who have many lotuses on your body. Salutations to you have half your body smeared with sandal paste, to you who have half your body decked with garlands of flowers and sıncared with fragınent unguents.

verses.sanskrit: नम आदित्यवक्त्राय आदित्यनयनाय च । नम आदित्यवर्णाय आदित्यप्रतिमाय च ॥२९६॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are bright-hued like the Sun, to you who are like the Sun, to you whose face is like the Sun, to you who have eyes each of which is like the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सोमाय सौम्याय सौम्यवक्त्रधराय च । सौम्यरूपाय मुख्याय सौम्यदंष्ट्राविभूषिणे ॥२९७॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are Soma, to you who are as mild as Soma, to you who bear the lunar disc, to you who are of lunar aspect, to you who are the foremost of all creatures, to you who are adorned with most beautiful teeth.

verses.sanskrit: नमः श्यामाय गौराय अर्धपीतार्धपाण्डवे । नारीनरशरीराय स्त्रीपुंसाय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥२९८॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are of a dark colour, to you who are of a fair complexion, to you who have a form half of which is yellow and half white, to you who have a body half of which is male and half female, to you who are both male and female.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वृषभवाहाय गजेन्द्रगमनाय च । दुर्गमाय नमस्तुभ्यमगम्यागमनाय च ॥२९९॥
verses.english: I bow to you who have bull for your vehicle, to you who proceed riding on the foremost of elephants, to you who are obtained with difficulty, to you who are capable of going to places unapproachable by others. I bow to you whose praises are sung by the Ganas, to you who are devoted to the various Ganas, to you who follow the track that is trod by the Ganas, to you who are always devoted to the Ganas as to a vow.

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽस्तु गणगीताय गणवृन्दरताय च । गणानुयातमार्गाय गणनित्यव्रताय च ॥३००॥
नमः श्वेताभ्रवर्णाय संध्यारागप्रभाय च । अनुद्दिष्टाभिधानाय स्वरूपाय नमोऽस्तु ते ॥३०१॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are of the complexion of white clouds, to you who have the splendour of the evening clouds, to you who are incapable of being described by names, lo you who are of your own form. I bow to you having a garland of red colour, to you who are clad in robes of red.

verses.sanskrit: नमो रक्ताग्रवासाय रक्तसूत्रधराय च । रक्तमालाविचित्राय रक्ताम्बरधराय च ॥३०२॥
मणिभूषितमूर्धाय नमश्चन्द्रार्धभूषिणे । विचित्रमणिमूर्धाय कुसुमाष्टधराय च ॥३०३॥
verses.english: I bow to you whose crown is set with gems, to you who are adorned with a crescent, to you who wear many beautiful gems in your diadem, to you who have eight flowers on your head.

verses.sanskrit: नमोऽग्निमुखनेत्राय सहस्रशशिलोचने । अग्निरूपाय कान्ताय नमोऽस्तु गहनाय च ॥३०४॥
verses.english: I bow to you who have a fiery mouth and fiery eyes, to you who have eyes effulgent like a thousand moons, to you who are of the form of fire, to you who are beautiful and agreeable, to you who are inconceivable and mysterious.

verses.sanskrit: खचराय नमस्तुभ्यं गोचराभिरताय च । भूचराय भुवनाय अनन्ताय शिवाय च ॥३०५॥
verses.english: I bow to you who range in the sky, to you who delight in living in pasture grounds, to you who walk on the Earth, to you who are the Earth, to you who are infinite, to you who are highly auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यमधिवाससुवाससे । नमो जगन्निवासाय प्रतिपत्तिसुखाय च ॥३०६॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are nude, to you who make a happy home of every place where you may happen to be for the time being. I bow to you who have the universe for your home, to you who have both Knowledge and Felicity for your Soul.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यमुद्बद्धमुकुटे महाकेयूरधारिणे । सर्पकंठोपहाराय विचित्राभरणाय च ॥३०७॥
verses.english: I bow to you who always wear a diadem, to you who wear a large armlet, to you who have a snake for the garland round your neck, to you who wear many beautiful ornaments on your body.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिनेत्रनेत्राय सहस्रशतलोचने । स्त्रीपुंसाय नपुंसाय नमः सांख्याय योगिने ॥३०८॥
verses.english: I bow to you who have the Sun, the Moon, and Agni for your three eyes, to you who have a thousand cyes, to you who are both male and female, to you who are divested of sex, to you who are a Sankhya, to you who are a Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: शंयोरभिस्रवन्ताय अथर्वाय नमो नमः । नमः सर्वार्तिनाशाय नमः शोकहराय च ॥३०९॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are the grace of those gods who are adored in sacrifices, to you who are the Atharvans, to you who remove all sorts of disease and pain, to you who remove every sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: नमो मेघनिनादाय बहुमायाधराय च । बीजक्षेत्राभिपालाय स्रष्ट्राराय नमो नमः ॥३१०॥
verses.english: I bow to you who roar as deep as the clouds, to you who display diverse kinds of illusions, to you who, lord over the soil and over the seed that is sown in it, to you who are the Creator of everything.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सुरासुरेशाय विश्वेशाय नमो नमः । नमः पवनवेगाय नमः पचनरूपिणे ॥३११॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are the Lord of all the deities, to you who are the Master of the universe, to you who are fleet like the wind, to you who are of the forin of the wind.

verses.sanskrit: नमः काञ्चनमालाय गिरिमालाय वै नमः । नमः सुरारिमालाय चण्डवेगाय वै नमः ॥३१२॥
verses.english: I bow to you who wear a garland of gold, to you who play on hills and mountains, to you who are adored by all who are enemics of the gods, to you who are endued with fierce speed and energy.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मशिरोपहर्ताय महिषघ्नाय वै नमः । नमः स्त्रीरूपधाराय यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च ॥३१३॥
verses.english: I bow to you who cut off one of the heads of the Grandfather Brahma, to you who have killed the Asura named Mahisha, to you who have three forms, to you who have every form.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिपुरहर्ताय यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च । नमः कामाङ्गनाशाय कालदण्डधराय च ॥३१४॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are the destroyer of the triple city of the Asuras, to you who are the destroyer of (Daksha's) sacrifice, to you who are the destroyer of the person of Kama (the god of love) to you who hold the rod of destruction.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कन्दविशाखाय ब्रह्मदण्डाय वै नमः । नमो भवाय शर्वाय विश्वरूपाय वै नमः ॥३१५॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are Skanda, to you who are Visakha, to you who are the rod of the are Brahmana, to you who are Bhava, to you who are Sarvam, to you who are of universal form.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाय भवघ्नाय नमोऽस्त्वन्धकघातिने । नमो विश्वाय मायाय चिन्त्याचिन्त्याय वै नमः ॥३१६॥
verses.english: I bow to you who are Ishana, to you who are the destroyer of Bhaga, to you who are the slayer of Andhaka, to you who are the universe, to you who are possessed of illusion, 10 you who both conceivable and inconceivable.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो गतिश्च श्रेष्ठश्च त्वमेव हृदयं तथा । त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रुद्राणां नीललोहितः ॥३१७॥
verses.english: You are the one end of all creatures, you are the foremost, you are the heart of everything. You are the Brahman of all the gods, you are the Red and Blue of the Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां सांख्ये पुरुष उच्यते । ऋषभस्त्वं पवित्राणां योगिनां निष्कलः शिवः ॥३१८॥
verses.english: You are the Soul of all creatures, you are He called Purusha in the Sankhya philosophy, you are the Rishava among all sacred things, you are the auspicious of the Yogins which, according to them, is indivisible.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थस्त्वमाश्रमिणामीश्वराणां महेश्वरः । कुबेरः सर्वयक्षाणां क्रतूनां विष्णुरुच्यते ॥३१९॥
verses.english: Amongst those who follow the different modes of life, you are the Householder, you are the great Lord amongst the patriarchs. You are Kubera among all the Yakshas, and you are Vishnu amongst all the sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानां भवान्मेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः । वसिष्ठस्त्वमृषीणां च ग्रहाणां सूर्य उच्यते ॥३२०॥
verses.english: You are Meru amongst mountains, you are the Moon among all luminaries of the sky, you are Vashishtha amongst Rishis, yon are the Sun among the planets.

verses.sanskrit: आरण्यानां पशूनां च सिंहस्त्वं परमेश्वरः । ग्राम्याणां गोवृषश्चासि भवाँल्लोकप्रपूजितः ॥३२१॥
verses.english: You are the lion among all the beasts, and the bull adored of all among all domestic animals. are are

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यानां भवान्विष्णुर्वसूनां चैव पावकः । पक्षिणां वैनतेयस्त्वमनन्तो भुजगेषु च ॥३२२॥
verses.english: Among the Adityas, you are Vishnu (Upendra), among the Vasus, you are Pavaka, among birds you are Garuda, and among snakes you are Ananta.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेदश्च वेदानां यजुषां शतरुद्रियम् । सनत्कुमारो योगानां सांख्यानां कपिलो ह्यसि ॥३२३॥
verses.english: Among the Vedas you arc thc Samans, among the Yajushes you the Shatarudriyam, among Yogins you Sanatkumara, and among Sankhyas you are Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रोऽसि मरुतां देव पितॄणां हव्यवाडसि । ब्रह्मलोकश्च लोकानां गतीनां मोक्ष उच्यसे ॥३२४॥
verses.english: Among the Maruts you are Shakra, among the Pitris you are Devarat, among all the regions you are the region of Brahman, and you are emancipation amongst all the ends of creatures.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदःसागराणां च शैलानां हिमवान्गिरिः । वर्णानां ब्राह्मणश्चासि विप्राणां दीक्षितो द्विजः ॥३२५॥
verses.english: Of all oceans you are the Ocean of Milk, among all mountains you are Himavat, among all the castes you are the Brahmanas, and among all learned Brahmanas you are he who has undergone the initiation.

verses.sanskrit: आदिस्त्वमसि लोकानां संहर्ता काल एव च । यच्चान्यदपि लोके वै सर्वतेजोधिकं स्मृतम् ॥३२६॥
verses.english: You are the Sun among all things in the worlds, you are the destroyer called Kala. You are whatever else gifted with superior energy or eminence existing in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं भगवानेव इति मे निश्चिता मतिः । नमस्ते भगवन् देव नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल ॥३२७॥
verses.english: You are endued with supreme power. This is my certain conclusion. I bow to you, O powerful and illustrious one, O you who are kind to all your worshippers.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वर नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते विश्वसंभव । प्रसीद मम भक्तस्य दीनस्य कृपणस्य च ॥३२८॥
verses.english: I bow to you, O lord of Yogins. I bow to you, O original Cause of the universe. Be you pleased with me that am your worshipper, that am very miserable and helpless.

verses.sanskrit: अनैश्वर्येण युक्तस्य गतिर्भव सनातन । यच्चापराधं कृतवानज्ञात्वा परमेश्वर ॥३२९॥
verses.english: O Eternal Lord, do you become the refuge of this adorer of yours who is very weak and miserable! O Supreme Lord, you should pardon me for all the sins i have committed, taking mercy on me for my being your devoted worshipper.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्त इति देवेश तत्सर्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि । मोहितश्चास्मि देवेश त्वया रूपविपर्ययात् ॥३३०॥
नार्घ्यं ते न मया दत्तं पाद्यं चापि महेश्वर । एवं स्तुत्वाऽहमीशानं पाद्यमर्घ्यं च भक्तितः ॥३३१॥
verses.english: I ain stupefied by you, O Lord of all the gods, on account of the disguise in which you appeared before me. O Maheshvara, I did not give you the Arghya or water to wash your feet.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयम् । ततः शीतांबुसंयुक्ता दिव्यगन्धसमन्विता ॥३३२॥
verses.english: Having sung thus the praises of Ishana, I offered him, with great devotion, water to wash his feet and the articles of the Arghya, and then, with joined hands I resigned myself to him, ready to carry out his command.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिः शुभा तात पपात मम मूर्धनि । दुन्दुभिश्च तदा दिव्यस्ताडितो देवकिङ्करैः । ववौ च मारुतः पुण्यः शुचिगन्धः सुखावहः ॥३३३॥
verses.english: The divine musicians began to play on their kettle drums. A delicious breeze fragrant and sweet, began to blow and fill me with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतो महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः । अब्रवीत्त्रिदशांस्तत्र हर्षयन्निव मां तदा ॥३३४॥
verses.english: Then Mahadeva accompanied by his wife, and having the bull for his emblem, having been pleased with me, addressed the deities assembled there in these words, filling me with great joy Behold, your gods, the devotion of the great Upamanyu. Indeed, steady and great is that devotion, and entirely fixed, for it remains unaltered.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यध्वं त्रिदशाः सर्वे उपमन्योर्महात्मनः । मयि भक्तिं परां नित्यमेकभावादवस्थिताम् ॥३३५॥
एवमुक्तास्तदा कृष्ण सुरास्ते शूलपाणिना । ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम् ॥३३६॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by the great God armed with the Shula, the gods, O Krishna, having bowed down to him and joined their hands in respect, said these words O illustrious one, O God of the gods, O Lord of the universe, O Lord of all, let this best of twice born persons obtain from you the fruition of all his desires!

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् देवदेवेश लोकनाथ जगत्पते । लभतां सर्वकामेभ्यः फलं त्वत्तो द्विजोत्तमः ॥३३७॥
एवमुक्तस्ततः शर्वः सुरैर्ब्रह्मादिभिस्तथा । आह मां भगवानीशः प्रहसन्निव शङ्करः ॥३३८॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by all the gods with the Grandfather Brahman among them, Sharva, otherwise called Isha and Shankara, said these words, as if smiling, to ine.

verses.sanskrit: भगवानुवाच । वत्सोपमन्यो तुष्टाऽस्मि पश्य मां मुनिपुङ्गव । दृढभक्तोऽसि विप्रर्षे मया जिज्ञासितो ह्यसि ॥३३९॥
verses.english: The illustrious Shankara said O dear Upamanyu, I am pleased with you. See me, O foremost of ascetics! O learned Rishi, you are firmly devoted to me and you have been well tested by me.

verses.sanskrit: अनया चैव भक्त्या ते अत्यर्थं प्रीतिमानहम् । तस्मात्सर्वान् ददाम्यद्य कामांस्तव यथेप्सितान् ॥३४०॥
verses.english: I have been very highly pleased with you on account of this your devotion to Shiva. I Shall, therefore, give you today the fruition of your desires.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्य चैवाथ महादेवेन धीमता । हर्षादश्रूण्यवर्तन्त रोमहर्षस्त्वजायत ॥३४१॥
verses.english: Thus' addressed by the highly wise Mahadeva, tears of joy came into my eyes and my hair stood crect.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रुवं च तदा देवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा । जानुभ्यामवनीं गत्वा प्रणम्य च पुनः पुनः ॥३४२॥
verses.english: Kneeling down to him and bowing to him repeatedly, I then with a voice that was Suppressed with joy, said to him.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य जातो ह्यह देव सफलं जन्म चाद्य मे । सुरासुरगुरुर्देवो यत्तिष्ठति ममाग्रतः ॥३४३॥
verses.english: O illustrious god, it appears to me that I was hitherto dead and that it is only today that I have taken my birth, and that my birth has today bomc fruit, since I am standing now in the presence of Him who is the Master of both the gods and the Asuras!

verses.sanskrit: यं न पश्यन्ति चैवाद्धा देवा ह्यमितविक्रमम् । तमहं दृष्टवान् देवं कोऽन्यो धन्यतरो मया ॥३४४॥
verses.english: Who clse is more praiseworthy than I, since I am seeing with these eyes of mine Him of immeasurable prowess whom the very gods are unable to see without first paying hearty worship?

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यायन्ति विद्वांसः परं तत्त्वं सनातनम् । तद्विशेषमिति ख्यातं यदजं ज्ञानमक्षरम् ॥३४५॥
verses.english: The learned and the wise consider that as the highest of all topics, which is Eternal, which is distinguished from all else, which is unborn, which is Knowledge, which is indestructible, at one with you o powerful and illustrious one, you who are the beginning of all the topics, you who are indestructible and challengeless, you who know all the ordinances, you who are the foremost of Purushas, you who are the highest of the high.

verses.sanskrit: स एष भगवान् देवः सर्वसत्त्वादिरव्ययः । सर्वतत्त्वविधानज्ञः प्रधानपुरुषः परः ॥३४६॥
योऽसृजद्दक्षिणादङ्गाद्ब्रह्माणं लोकसंभवम् । वामपार्श्वात्तथा विष्णुं लोकरक्षार्थमीश्वरः ॥३४७॥
verses.english: You who had created from your right side the Grandfather Brahman, the Creator of all things, you are he who had created from your leftside Vishnu for protecting the Creation.

verses.sanskrit: युगान्ते चैव संप्राप्ते रुद्रमीशोऽसृजत्प्रभुः । स रुद्रः संहरन् कृत्स्नं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ॥३४८॥
verses.english: You are that powerful Lord who did create Rudra when the end of the cycle came and when the Creation was once more to be destroyed! That Rudra who originated from you destroyed the Creation with all its mobile and immobile beings, assuming the form of highly powerful Kala, of the cloud Samvartaka, and of the all destroying fire. Indeed, when the time for the dissolution of the universe sets in, that Rudra stands, ready to swallow up the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कालो भूत्वा महातेजाः संवर्तक इवानलः । युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि ग्रसन्निव व्यवस्थितः ॥३४९॥
एष देवो महादेवो जगत्सृष्ट्वा चराचरम् । कल्पान्ते चैव सर्वेषां स्मृतिमाक्षिप्य तिष्ठति ॥३५०॥
verses.english: You are that Mahadeva who is the original Creator of the universe with all its mobile and immobile creatures. You are he who, at the end of the aeon stands, withdrawing all things into yourself.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगः सर्वभूतात्मा सर्वभूतभवोद्भवः । आस्ते सर्वगतो नित्यमदृश्यः सर्वदैवतैः ॥३५१॥
verses.english: You are he who pervades all things, you are the Soul of all things, you are the Creator of all principles. Incapable of being beheld by even any of the gods, you are he who exists, pervading all principles.

verses.sanskrit: यदि देयो वरो मह्यं यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो । भक्तिर्भवतु मे नित्यं त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर ॥३५२॥
verses.english: If, O Lord, you have been pleased with me and if you would grant me boons, let this be the boon, O Lord of all the gods, that my devotion to you may remain unchanged.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतं चैव वर्तमानं च यद्विभो । जानीयामिति मे बुद्धिः प्रसादात्सुरसत्तम ॥३५३॥
verses.english: O best of the gods, let me through your grace, have knowledge of the Present, the Past, and the Future.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदनं च भुञ्जीयामक्षयं सह बान्धवैः । आश्रमे च सदाऽस्माकं सान्निध्यं परमस्तु ते ॥३५४॥
verses.english: I shall also, with all my kinsmen and friends, always eat food mixed with milk. And let your illustrious self be for ever present at our gifted hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स मां प्राह भगवाल्लोঁकपूजितः । महेश्वरो महातेजाश्चराचरगुरुः शिवः ॥३५५॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by me, the illustrious Maheshvara gifted with supreme energy, that Master of all mobile and immobile creations, viz., Shiva, adored of all the universe, then said to me these words.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच । अजरश्चामरश्चैव भव त्वं दुःखवर्जितः । यशस्वी तेजसा युक्तो दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः ॥३५६॥
verses.english: The Illustrious God said Be free from every misery and pain and be above decrepitude and death. Be gifted with fame, be endued with great energy, and spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणामभिगम्यश्च मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि । शीलवान् गुणसंपन्नः सर्वज्ञः प्रियदर्शनः ॥३५७॥
verses.english: You shall through my grace, be always sought by the Rishis. Be your behaviour good and righteous. May you possess all attributes and universal knowledge. Be you of agreeable appearance.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं यौवनं तेऽस्तु तेजश्चैवानलोपमम् । क्षीरोदः सागरश्चैव यत्र यत्रेच्छसि प्रियम् ॥३५८॥
verses.english: May you possess everlasting youth, and let your energy be like that of fire. Whenever, again, you may wish for the presence, which is so agreeable to you, of the ocean of milk, there shall that ocean appear before you. Do you, with your friends, always obtain food prepared with milk, with the celestial nectar being mixed। with it.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते भविता कामं सान्निध्यं पयसो निधेः । क्षीरोदनं च भुङ्क्ष्व त्वममृतेन समन्वितम् ॥३५९॥
बन्धुभिः सहितः कल्पं ततो मामुपयास्यसि । अक्षया बान्धवाश्चैव कुलं गोत्रं च ते सदा ॥३६०॥
verses.english: After the expiration of an acon you will enjoy my company. Unending shall be your family and race and Kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ मयि भक्तिश्च शाश्वती । सान्निध्यं चाश्रमे नित्यं करिष्यामि द्विजोत्तम ॥३६१॥
verses.english: O foremost of twiceborn ones, your devotion to me shall be eternal. And, O best of Brahmanas. I shall always be present at your hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठ वत्स यथाकामं नोत्कण्ठां च करिष्यसि । स्मृतस्त्वया पुनर्विप्र करिष्यामि च दर्शनम् ॥३६२॥
verses.english: Live, O son, wherever you like shorn of anxiety. Thought of by you, I shall, O learned Brahmana, appear before you again.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः । ईशानः स वरान् दत्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥३६३॥
verses.english: Having said these words, and granted me these boons, the illustrious Ishana, effulgent like millions of Suns, disappeared there and then.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्टो मया कृष्ण देवदेवः समाधिना । तदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं यदुक्तं तेन धीमता ॥३६४॥
verses.english: It was even, O Krishna, that I saw, with the help of austere penances, that God of gods. I also got all that was said by the great God endued with supreme intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं चैव ते कृष्ण पश्य सिद्धान्व्यवस्थितान् । ऋषीन् विद्याधरान्यक्षान् गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा ॥३६५॥
verses.english: See, O Krishna, before your eyes, these Siddhas living here and these Rishis and Vidyadharas and Yakshas and Gandharvas and Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit: पश्य वृक्षलतागुल्मान् सर्वपुष्पफलप्रदान् । सर्वर्तुकुसुमैर्युक्तान्सुखपत्रान् सुगन्धिनः ॥३६६॥
verses.english: See these trees and creepers and plants yielding all sorts of flowers and fruits. See them bearing the flowers of every season, with beautiful leaves, and spreading a sweet smell all around.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमेतन्महाबाहो दिव्यभावसमन्वितम् । प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य ईश्वरस्य महात्मनः ॥३६७॥
verses.english: O you of mighty arms, all these are gifted with a celestial nature through the favour of that god of gods, that supreme Lord, that great Deity.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच। एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य प्रत्यक्षमिव दर्शनम् । विस्मयं परमं गत्वा अध्रुवं तं महामुनिम् ॥३६८॥
verses.english: Vasudeva continued Hearing these words of his and seeing, as it were, with my own eyes all that he had described to me, I became filled with wonder. I then addressed the great ascetic Upamanyu and said to him, Highly praiseworthy as you are, O foremost of learned Brahmanas, for what righteous man is there except you whose retreat enjoys the distinction of being honoured with the presence of that God of gods.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यस्त्वमसिविप्रेन्द्र कस्त्वदन्योऽस्ति पुण्यकृत् । यस्य देवाधिदेवस्ते सान्निध्यं कुरुतेऽऽश्रमे ॥३६८॥
verses.english: Vasudeva continued Hearing these words of his and seeing, as it were, with my own eyes all that he had described to me, I became filled with wonder. I then addressed the great ascetic Upamanyu and said to him, Highly praiseworthy as you are, O foremost of learned Brahmanas, for what righteous man is there except you whose retreat enjoys the distinction of being honoured with the presence of that God of gods.

verses.sanskrit: अपि तावन्ममाप्येवं दद्यात्स भगवाञ्छिवः । दर्शनं मुनिशार्दूल प्रसादं चापि शंकरः ॥३७०॥
verses.english: Will the powerful Shiva, will the great Shankara, O chief of ascetics, grant me also a sight of his body and show me favour?

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युरुवाच । द्रक्ष्यसे पुण्डरीकाक्ष महादेवं न संशयः । अचिरेणैव कालेन यथा दृष्टो मयाऽनघ ॥३७१॥
verses.english: Upamanyu said Forsooth, O you having eyes like lotus petals, you will very soon see Mahadeva as, O sinless one, I succeeded in seeing him.

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुषा चैव दिव्येन पश्याम्यमितविक्रमम् । षष्ठे मासि महादेवं द्रक्ष्यसे पुरुषोत्तम ॥३७२॥
verses.english: O you of immeasurable prowess, I see with my spiritual eyes that you will in the sixth month from, this, succeed in getting a sight of Mahadeva, O best of all persons.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशाष्टौ वरांश्चापि प्राप्स्यसि त्वं महेश्वरात् । सपत्नीकाद्यदुश्रेष्ठ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ॥३७३॥
verses.english: You, O foremost of the Yadus, will obtain from Maheshvara and his wife twentyfour boons. I tell you what is true.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागतं चैव वर्तमानं च नित्यशः । विदितं मे महाबाहो प्रसादात्तस्य धीमतः ॥३७४॥
verses.english: Through the favour of that Deity gifted with supreme wisdom, I know the Past, the Future, and the Present.

verses.sanskrit: एतान्सहस्रशश्चान्यान्समनुध्यातवान्हरः । कस्मात्प्रसादं भगवान्न कुर्यात्तव माधव ॥३७५॥
verses.english: The great Hara has favoured these thousands of Rishis and others. Why will not the powerful Deity show favour to you, O Madhava! I always like the meeting of the gods as does one like you, who is devoted to the Brahmanas, who is full of mercy and who is full of faith. I shall give you certain Mantras. Recite them continuously. By this you are sure to see Shankara!

verses.sanskrit: त्वादृशेन हि देवानां श्लाघनीयः समागमः । ब्रह्मण्येनानृशंसेन श्रद्दधानेन चाप्युत ॥३७६॥
जप्यं तु ते प्रदास्यामि येन द्रक्ष्यसि शङ्करम् । श्रीकृष्ण उवाच । अब्रुवं तमहं ब्रह्मन् त्वत्प्रसादान्महामुने ॥३७७॥
द्रक्ष्ये दितिजसंघानां मर्दनं त्रिदशेश्वरम् । एवं कथयतस्तस्य महादेवाश्रितां कथाम् ॥३७८॥
verses.english: The blessed Vishnu said I then said to him O twiceborn one, through your favour, O great ascetic, I shall see the lord of the deities, that grinder of Diti's numberless sons.

verses.sanskrit: दिनान्यष्टौ ततो जग्मुर्मुहूर्तमिव भारत । दिनेऽष्टमे तु विप्रेण दीक्षितोऽहं यथाविधि ॥३७९॥
verses.english: Eight days, O Bharata, passed there like an hour, all of us being thus occupied with talk on Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डी मुण्डी कुशी चीरी घृताक्तो मेखली कृतः । मासमेकं फलाहारो द्वितीयं सलिलाशनः ॥३८०॥
verses.english: On the eighth day, I underwent the initiation according to due rites, at the hands of that Brahmana. I received the staff from his hands. I went through the prescribed shave. I took up a quantity of Kusha blades in my hand. I wore rags for my raiment's. I rubbed my person with clarified butter. I put a cord of Munja grass round my loins.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं च चतुर्थं च पञ्चमं चानिलाशनः । एकपादेन तिष्ठंश्च ऊर्ध्वबाहुरतन्द्रितः ॥३८१॥
verses.english: For one month, I lived on fruits. The second month I lived upon water. The third, the fourth, and the fifth months I passed, living upon air only.

verses.sanskrit: तेजः सूर्यसहस्रस्य अपश्यं दिवि भारत । तस्य मध्यगतं चापि तेजसः पाण्डुनन्दन ॥३८२॥
verses.english: I stood all the while, upon one foot, and with my arms also raised upwards, and giving up sleep for all the time. I then saw, O Bharata, in the sky a light that seemed to be as dazzling as that of a thousand Suns.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रायुधपिनद्धाङ्गं विद्युन्मालागवाक्षकम् । नीलशैलचयप्रख्यं बलाकाभूषिताम्बरम् ॥३८३॥
verses.english: Towards the centre of that effulgence, O son of Pandu, I saw a cloud loO king like a mass of blue hills, adorned with rows of cranes, decorated with many a grand rainbow, with flashes of lightning and the fire loO king like eyes set on it.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्थितश्च भगवान् देव्या सह महाद्युतिः । तपसा तेजसा कान्त्या दीप्तया सह भार्यया ॥३८४॥
verses.english: Within that cloud was the powerful Mahadeva, himself of dazzling splendour, accompanied by his consort Uma. Indeed, the great God appeared to shine with his penances, energy, beauty, effulgence, and his beloved consort by his side.

verses.sanskrit: रराज भगवांस्तत्र देव्या सह महेश्वरः । सोमेन सहितः सूर्यो यथा मेघस्थितस्तथा ॥३८५॥
verses.english: The powerful Maheshvara, with his wife by his side, shone in the midst of that cloud. The appearance seemed to be like that of the Sun in the midst of clouds with the Moon by his side.

verses.sanskrit: संहृष्टरोमा कौन्तेय विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः । अपश्यं देवसंघानां गतिमार्तिहरं हरम् ॥३८६॥
verses.english: The hair on my body, O son of Kunti, stood erect, and my eyes expanded with wonder upon seeing Hara, the refuge of all the gods and the remover of all their griefs.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं शूलपाणिं व्याघ्राजिनं जटिलं दण्डपाणिम् । पिनाकिनं वज्रिणं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं शुभाङ्गदं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतम् ॥३८७॥
verses.english: Mahadeva was adorned with a diadem on his head. He was armed with his Shula. He was clad in a tigerskin, had matted locks on his head, and bore the staff in one of his hands. He was armed, besides, with his Pinaka and the thunderbolt. His teeth were sharp pointed. He was adorned with an excellent bracelet for the upper arm. His sacred thread was formed by a snake.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यां मालासुरसाऽनेकवर्णां समुद्वहन्तं गुल्फदेशावलम्बाम् । चन्द्रं यथा परिविष्टं ससन्ध्यं वर्षात्यये तद्वदपश्यमेनम् ॥३८८॥
verses.english: He wore an excellent garland of various colours on his bosom, that hung down to his toes. Indeed, I saw him like the highly bright moon of an autumnal evening.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमथानां गणैश्चैव समन्तात्परिवारितम् । शरदीव सुदुष्प्रेक्ष्यं परिविष्टं दिवाकरम् ॥३८९॥
verses.english: Surrounded by various clans of spirits and ghosts, he appeared like the autumnal Sun difficult of being looked at for its dazzling brightness.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशशतान्येवं रुद्राणां वृषवाहनम् । अस्तुवं नियतात्मानं कर्मभिः शुभकर्मिणम् ॥३९०॥
verses.english: A thousand and hundred Rudras stood around that God of controlled soul and white deeds, seated upon his bull. All of them were employed in singing his praises.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवः साध्या विश्वेदेवास्तथाऽश्विनौ । विश्वाभिस्तुतिभिर्देवं विश्वदेवं समस्तुवम् ॥३९१॥
verses.english: The Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, and the twin Ashvins praised that Lord of the universe, by singing the hymns.

verses.sanskrit: शतक्रतुश्च भगवान् विष्णुश्चादितिनन्दनौ । ब्रह्मा रथन्तरं साम ईरयन्ति भवान्तिके ॥३९२॥
verses.english: The powerful Indra and his brother Upendra, the two sons of Aditi, and the Grandfather Brahman, all sang in the presence of Bhava the Rathantara Saman.

verses.sanskrit: योगीश्वराः सुबहवो योगदं पितरं गुरुम् । ब्रह्मर्षयश्च ससुतास्तथा देवर्षयश्च वै ॥३९३॥
verses.english: Numberless masters of Yoga, all the twiceborn Rishis with their children, all the celestial Rishis, the goddess Earth, the Sky, the Constellations, the Planets, the Months, the Fortnights, the Seasons, Night, the Years, the Kshanas, the Muhurtas, the Nimeshas, the Yugas one after another, all the celestial Sciences and branches of knowledge, all beings conversant with Truth, were seen bowing down that Supreme Preceptor, that great Father, that giver of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च नक्षत्राणि ग्रहास्तथा । मासार्धमासा ऋतवो रात्रिः संवत्सराः क्षणाः ॥३९४॥
मुहूर्ताश्च निमेषाश्च तथैव युगपर्ययाः । दिव्या राजन्नमस्यन्ति विद्याः सत्त्वविदस्तथा ॥३९५॥
सनत्कुमारो देवाश्च इतिहासास्तथैव च । मरीचिरङ्गिरा अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ॥३९६॥
verses.english: Sanatkumara, the Vedas, the Histories, Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, the seven Manus, Soma, the Atharvans, and Brihaspati, Bhrigu, Daksha, Kashyapa, Vasishtha, Kashya, the Chchandas, Diksha, the Sacrifices, Dakshina, the Sacrificial Fires, the Haris poured in sacrifices, and all the articles of the sacrifices, . were seen by me, O Yudhishthira, standing there in their embodied forms.

verses.sanskrit: मनवः सप्त सोमश्च अथर्वा सबृहस्पतिः । भृगुर्दक्षः कश्यपश्च वसिष्ठः काश्य एव च ॥३९७॥
छन्दांसि दीक्षा यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाः पावको हविः । यज्ञोपगानि द्रव्याणि मूर्तिमन्ति युधिष्ठिर ॥३९८॥
प्रजानां पालकाः सर्वे सरितः पन्नगा नगाः । देवानां मातरः सर्वा देवपत्न्यः सकन्यकाः ॥३९९॥
verses.english: All the presiding deities of the worlds, all the Rivers, all the snakes, the mountains, the celestial Mothers, all the wives and daughters of the celestials, thousands upon thousands and millions of ascetics, were seen to bow down to that powerful Lord who is the soul of tranquility. The Mountains, the Oceans, and the Points of the compass also did the same, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras highly proficient in music, in celestial songs, sang and hymned the praises of Bhava who is full of wonder, The Vidyadharas, the Danavas, the Guhyakas, the Rakshasas, and all created beings mobile and immobile were worshipping, in thought, word, and deed that powerful Lord.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राणि मुनीनां च अयुतान्यर्बुदानि च । नमस्यन्ति प्रभुं शान्तं पर्वताः सागरा दिशः ॥४००॥
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गीतवादित्रकोविदाः । दिव्यतालेषु गायन्तः स्तुवन्ति भवमद्भुतम् ॥४०१॥
विद्याधरा दानवाश्च गुह्यका राक्षसास्तथा । सर्वाणि चैव भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । नमस्यन्ति महाराज वाङ्मनःकर्मभिर्विभुम् ॥४०२॥
पुरस्ताद्धिष्ठितः शर्वो ममासीत्त्रिदशेश्वरः । पुरस्ताद्धिष्ठितं दृष्ट्वा ममेशानं च भारत ॥४०३॥
verses.english: That Lord of all the gods, viz., Sarva, appeared before me, seated in all his glory. Seeing that Ishana had showed himself to me by being seated in glory before my eyes, the whole universe, with the Grandfather and Shakra, looked at me.

verses.sanskrit: सप्रजापतिशक्रान्तं जगन्मामभ्युदैक्षत । ईक्षितुं च महादेवं न मे शक्तिरभूत्तदा ॥४०४॥
verses.english: I, however, had not the power to look at Mahadeva. The great god then addressed me, saying see, OKrishna, and speak to me!

verses.sanskrit: ततो मामब्रवीद्देवः पश्य कृष्ण वदस्व च । त्वया ह्याराधितश्चाहं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥४०५॥
verses.english: You have worshipped me hundreds and thousands of times. There is no one in the three worlds who is dearer to me than you!

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्समो नास्ति मे कश्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु वै प्रियः । शिरसा वन्दिते देवे देवी प्रीता ह्युमा तदा । ततोऽहमब्रुवं स्थाणुं स्तुतं ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरैः ॥४०६॥
verses.english: After I had bowed to him, his wife, viz., the goddess Uma, became pleased with me. I then addressed in these words the great God whose praises are hymned by all the gods headed by the Grandfather Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण उवाच । नमोऽस्तु ते शाश्वत सर्वयोने ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति । तपश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तमश्च त्वामेव सत्यं च वदन्ति सन्तः ॥४०७॥
verses.english: I saluted Mahadeva, saying I bow to you, o you, who are the origin of all things. The Rishis declare that you are the master of the Vedas. The pious hold that you are Penance, you are Sattwa, you are Rajas, you are Tamas, and you are Truth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वै ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च वरुणोऽग्निर्मनुर्भवः । धाता त्वष्टा विधाता च त्वं प्रभुः सर्वतोमुखः ॥४०८॥
verses.english: You are Brahman, you are Rudra, you are Veruna, you are Agni, you are Manu, you are Bhava, you are Dhatri, you are Tashtri, you are Vidhatri, you are the powerful Lord of all things, you are everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तो जातानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । त्वया सृष्टमिदं कृत्स्नं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ॥४०९॥
verses.english: All beings, mobile and immobile, have originated from you. You have created this world with all its mobile and immobile creations.

verses.sanskrit: यानीन्द्रियाणीह मनश्च कृत्स्नं ये वायवः सप्त तथैव चाग्नयः । य देवसंस्थास्तवदेवताश्च तस्मात्परं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति ॥४१०॥
verses.english: The Rishis say that you are superior to the senses, the mind, the vital air, the seven fires, everything else which rests upon the allpervading Soul and all the celestials who are worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाश्च यज्ञाः सोमश्च दक्षिणा पावको हविः । यज्ञोपगं च यत्किञ्चिद्भगवांस्तदसंशयम् ॥४११॥
verses.english: You, O illustrious one, are the Vedas, the Sacrifices, Soma. Dakshina, Pavaka, Havi and all other ingredients of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टं दत्तमधीतं च व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये । ह्रीः कीर्तिः श्रीर्द्युतिस्तुष्टिः सिद्धिश्चैव तदर्पणी ॥४१२॥
verses.english: The merit of sacrifices, gifts, the study of the Vedas, vows, practices of restraint, Modesty, Fame, Prosperity, Glory, Contentment, and Success, are all for acquiring you.

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधो भयं लोभो मदः स्तम्भोऽथ मत्सरः । आधयो व्याधयश्चैव भगवंस्तनवस्तव ॥४१३॥
verses.english: Desire, Anger, Fear, Cupidity, Pride, Stupefaction, and Malice, Pains and Diseases, are, O illustrious one, all your offspring.

verses.sanskrit: कृतिर्विकारः प्रणयः प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम् । मनसः परमा योनिः प्रभावश्चापि शाश्वतः ॥४१४॥
verses.english: You are the acts of creatures, you are the joy and sorrow of those acts, you are the absence of joy and sorrow, you are that Nescience which is the eternal seeds of Desire, you are the great origin of Mind, you are Power, and you are Eternity.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तः पावनोऽचिन्त्यः सहस्त्रांशुर्हिरण्मयः । आदिर्गणानां सर्वेषां भवान्वै जीविताश्रयः ॥४१५॥
verses.english: You are the Unmanifest, you are Pavana, you are inconceivable, you are the thousand rayed Sun, you are the shining intelligence, you are the first of all the subjects, and you are the support of life.

verses.sanskrit: महानात्मा मतिर्ब्रह्मा विश्वः शम्भुः स्वयंभुवः । बुद्धिः प्रज्ञोपलब्धिश्च संवित्ख्यातिर्धृतिः स्मृतिः ॥४१६॥
verses.english: By the words Greatness, Soul Understanding, Brahman, Universe, Shambhu, and Selfcreate, as well as other words seen (in the Vedas), your nature is comprehended as being at one with Greatness and Soul. Knowing you as all this, the learned Brahmana conquers that Ignorance which is the root of the world.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैर्महानात्मा विभाव्यते । त्वां बुद्ध्वा ब्राह्मणो वेदात्प्रमोहं विनियच्छति ॥४१७॥
हृदयं सर्वभूतानां क्षेत्रज्ञस्त्वमृषिस्तुतः । सर्वतः पाणिपादस्त्वं सर्वतोक्षिशिरोमुखः ॥४१८॥
verses.english: You are the heart of all creatures, and you are worshipped by the Rishis as Soul. Your arms and feet extend to every place, and your eyes, head, and face are everywhere. You hear everywhere in the universe, and you exist permeating everything.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः श्रुतिमाँल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठसि । फलं त्वमसि तिग्मांशोर्निमेषादिषु कर्मसु ॥४१९॥
verses.english: You are the fruit of all acts which are performed in the Nimeshas and other divisions of time which originate from the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वै प्रभार्चिः पुरुषः सर्वस्य हृदि संश्रितः । अणिमा महिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः ॥४२०॥
verses.english: You are the original lustre. You are Male Being living in the hearts of all things. You are the successful fruits of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि बुद्धिर्मतिर्लोकाः प्रपन्नाः संश्रिताश्च ये । ध्यानिनो नित्ययोगाश्च सत्यसत्त्वा जितेन्द्रियाः ॥४२१॥
verses.english: Understanding and Intelligence and all the worlds depend upon you. Those who are given to meditation, who are always busy with Yoga, who are devoted to or firm in Truth and who have conquered their passions, seek you and depend on you.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वां ध्रुवं वेदयते गुहाशयं प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं च विग्रहम् । हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति ॥४२२॥
verses.english: They who know you the unchangeable, or one who lives in all hearts, or one who is endowed with supreme power, or one who is the ancient Male Being, or one who is pure Knowledge, or one that is the effulgent understanding, or one that is the highest refuge of all persons gifted with intelligence, are, indeed, highly intelligent men. Indeed such persons reign supreme over intelligence. as one seven

verses.sanskrit: विदित्वा सप्त सूक्ष्माणि षडङ्गं त्वां च मूर्तितः । प्रधानविधियोगस्थस्त्वामेव विशते बुधः ॥४२३॥
verses.english: By understanding the subtile principles, by comprehending your six attributes, and by mastering the true Yoga, the man of knowledge succeeds in entering into your great self.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते मया पार्थ भवे चार्तिविनाशने । चराचरं जगत्सर्वं सिंहनादं तदाऽकरोत् ॥४२४॥
verses.english: After I had said these words, O Partha, to Bhava, that remover of grief and pain, the universe, both mobile and immobile, roared like a lion.

verses.sanskrit: तं विप्रसंघाश्च सुरासुराश्च नागाः पिशाचाः पितरो वयांसि । रक्षोगणा भूतगणाश्च सर्वे महर्षयश्चैव तदा प्रणेमुः ॥४२५॥
verses.english: The numberless Brahmans present there, the gods and the Asuras, the Nagas, the Pishachas, the Pitris, the birds, various Rakshasas various classes of ghosts and spirits, and all the great Rishis, then bowed down to that great Deity.

verses.sanskrit: मम मूर्ध्नि च दिव्यानां कुसुमानां सुगन्धिनाम् । राशयो निपतन्ति स्म वायुश्च सुसुखो ववौ ॥४२६॥
verses.english: There then, dropped upon my head showers of highly fragrant celestial flowers and sweet winds blew on the spot.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य भगवान् देवीं ह्युमां मां च जगद्धितः । शतक्रतुं चाभिवीक्ष्य स्वयं मामाह शङ्करः ॥४२७॥
verses.english: The powerful Shankara then, given to the behoof of the universe, looked at the goddess Uma, and the king of the celestials and myself also, and thus spoke to me.

verses.sanskrit: विदुः कृष्ण परां भक्तिमस्मासु तव शत्रुहन् । क्रियतामात्मनः श्रेयः प्रीतिर्हि त्वाय मे परा ॥४२८॥
verses.english: We know, O Krishna, that you, O slayer of foes, are greatly devoted to us! Do what is for your good. My love and affection for you is very great.

verses.sanskrit: वृणीष्वाष्टौ वरान् कृष्ण दाताऽस्मि तव सत्तम । ब्रूहि यादवशार्दूल यानिच्छसि सुदुर्लभान् ॥४२९॥
verses.english: Do you ask for eight boons. I shall grant them, O Krishna, O best of all persons. Tell me what they are, O chief of the Yadavas. Say what you wish. You will have them, however difficult of attainment they may be.
